en.headline: DFEN is the main reason the portfolio trails its benchmark
en.what_happened: The model portfolio fell 2.08% this week, against -2.40% for the benchmark (70% VWCE / 30% EUNA). Since 14 August 2026 it returned -2.51% against -1.67%, a shortfall of 0.83 percentage points.
en.why: The largest effect came from DFEN: -2.05 percentage points (weight 12.1%, own return -18.38%). The strongest contribution came from IQQQ: +0.52 percentage points.
en.what_we_do: The rules lead to 6 trades this week; 4 new positions follow in the coming weeks because of the limit of 2 fund changes per week.
